Commentary.Commentary: Now, the chase is tall and won't be an easy one by any means. A target of 322 seems daunting enough, and with the track about to slow up even more, the fight against the Indian spinners will test the character and the skill of the Windies batsmen. Join us on the other side of the break for all the action.

Ambati Rayudu is caught on the sidelines for a little chat. He says that it was an important situation to build a stand and he is happy it worked out well. Smiles and states that he always tries to make the most of the opportunities he gets. Mentions that all throughout his career he has batted in the middle order and he is quite used to it. Admits that the Indian T20 League is a great platform and thanks Dhoni and Chennai. On batting with Kohli, Rayudu says that it's really unbelievable and the Indian skipper has taken his game to whole new level.

Not much to mention about the Windies bowling. Barring Nurse (who was their best) and Bishoo (who was economical), the rest got a hammering as they were sent to all parts of the ground by the Indian captain. Kohli's dropped chance on 44 by Jason Holder has surely haunted them. The Windies skipper didn't even bowl his full quota of overs for some reason.

Kohli joined hands with Rayudu and set it all up with a 139-run partnership. The latter departed after scoring a fine 73, but the captain carried on, despite him feeling the heat (literally). Made some useful stands with the rest coming in, the one with Jadeja worth 59 was the pick of them, and the skipper remained unbeaten till the end, powering the Men in Blue to 321.

India have posted a superb total on the board courtesy another masterclass from Virat Kohli. The Indian skipper doesn't seem to get tired of scoring big runs. Back-to-back hundreds, also broke several records on the way. Incredible effort, especially considering that Rohit and Dhawan were dismissed quite early.
Spears a yorker outside off, Shami can't get bat to ball. 13 runs off the over and that signals the end of the innings. INDIA FINISH ON 321/6!
Full again, wide outside off once more. Kohli lifts it over covers for just the single on this occasion.

SIX! Oh, you beauty! How do you do this? Makes it all look so easy. Just ahead of a length outside off, Kohli reaches out to it and lofts it over wide long on. The fielder there is right at the rope, he leaps but it's over his head.
Virat Kohli is just amazing. His 4th 150-plus score in ODIs. He carves this full delivery outside off square through cover-point. Runs hard, comes back for the second and gets in with a dive. Superb.

FOUR! Innovative stuff from Virat Kohli. You don't see much of this from him. Wide outside off, Kohli goes a long way across and paddles it wide of backward square leg. The fielder gives it a chase, dives but can't stop it. Boundary results.
Arrows this really full, outside off, drilled straight to the cover fielder.
Pushes this full delivery towards point and keeps strike with a single.
Mohammed Shami to bat next for India.

OUT! Jadeja departs in the quest for the big hits. Full and in the slots, Jadeja looks to go big downtown but can't get underneath it. Skies it towards long on where Kieran Powell takes a safe catch. End of the all-rounder's relatively short stay in the middle. Useful stand comes to a close.
Short of a good length angling across, pulled aerially over mid-wicket for a run.
Yorker tailing back in on leg, Jadeja misses his flick and it goes off his pads on the off side. A leg bye is taken.
Darts this full delivery outside off, VK smacks it aerially to long off. Just the single this time.
Low full toss on off, slogged off the inner half by Jadeja and he finds deep mid-wicket. One run taken. Brings Kohli back on strike.

FOUR! Roach has been taken to the cleaners by Kohli. The 300 is up for India. Full in length and well outside off, Kohli eyes that cover area and lofts it over the fielder there, just outside the ring. A boundary to end the over. 36 runs from the last two overs.
Full toss, Virat doesn't time it well but it's enough to fetch him a couple as he places it wide of long off.
Switches the angle to around the wicket, spears in a yorker on off, Jadeja crouches and squeezes it out behind point for one.
Drives this full delivery through covers for a single.

FOUR! Streaky runs but they're all the same to the Indians. Wide outside off, full in length, Kohli reaches out to squeeze it out on the off side but gets it off the bottom edge, past the keeper to the third man fence.

SIX! Dear, oh dear! That's a beautiful hit. The Vizag crowd goes crazy as Virat Kohli is on fire. Full and wide outside off, the Indian skipper gets low and lifts it cleanly over covers for a maximum.
Kemar Roach to have a change of ends.
Wide yorker outside off, squeezed out square towards point for a single. There is a shy which misses at the bowler's end, so the batsmen take another. 18 from this over.
Angling away from around off, guided to third man for a single.

SIX! Going on the offensive here now. Superb. Full again, it's the slower one this time, Kohli picks it up and so he gets low to this one. Launches it high and handsome over wide long on for a biggie. 15 off the over so far.
Kohli gives the charge and seeing this, McCoy lands it short around leg. Kohli still manages to help the pull towards short fine leg. A misfield there allows the batsmen to take two.

SIX! Right out of the screws! What a hit, Virat Kohli. Wow. Full and in the slot, Kohli stands firm and gives it the full swing of the bat. Middles it well and sends it deep into the long on stands for a huge maximum. With this, Virat Kohli becomes the fastest to get 1000 ODI runs in a calendar year (11 innings).
Length delivery just outside off, dabbed behind point for a run.
Obed McCoy returns.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot in front of point. They pick up a single.
Flicked away with the wrists behind square leg for one.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Shortish delivery, Kohli doesn't exactly middle the pull but still manages to place it just wide of deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tad short, outside off, punched through to sweeper cover for a single.
Sliding in on middle and leg, whipped through the gap in the mid-wicket region for a brace.
A friendly warning from umpire Ian Gould. He saw that the Indian batsmen had called for some fluids, but since it's come on a few times too many today, he just lets it be known.
Slower length ball outside off, run down to third man for a single.
Plays this through square leg and crosses over.

Not out. Clearly. Jadeja drives this off the outer half behind square on the off side. The first run is taken, then Jadeja takes off for the second when Kohli isn't even looking. He has to rush back to the bowler's end as the keeper throws it to Roach. The bails are off but Jaddu is in. Replays confirm the same.
A run out appeal against Jadeja is taken upstairs.
Full delivery outside off, pushed off the front foot by Jadeja to the cover fielder.
Fraction straight in line, flicked through to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length outside off, drags it through mid-wicket and comes back for the second.
Kemar Roach is back.
Flicks it away on the leg side and takes a single.

FOUR! Century number 37 for Virat Kohli in ODI cricket. Brings it up in some style too. He was dropped on 44, but he's made the most of it here. Short and wide outside off, the Indian captain rocks onto the back foot and crunches it through the covers to find the fence. Been a controlled knock so far.
Flat ball outside off, Jadeja pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Ravindra Jadeja walks into the middle next.

OUT! Pant is gone! Short and flat from around the wicket, sliding in, keeps a little low as Pant goes for the wild slog across the line. It goes under the bat as a result and catches the left-hander on the pads. Loud shout and the finger goes up. Pant talks it out with his skipper and signals the 'T'. Replays roll in and show three reds. Another wicket down for India.
Review taken. Rishabh Pant has been caught leg before and he's taken the DRS against it. Looks out to the naked eye. Over to the TV umpire now...
Looking for two but will get just the one. Kohli pushes it through mid on and runs the first one hard. Wants the second but won't get it as the fielder gets to the ball quickly.
Room offered outside off, slapped to sweeper cover for a single.
Slower length delivery on leg, picked off the pads and flicked to square leg.
FOUR! Picked the gap so, so well. Short of a length on off, Kohli takes a step across, gets behind the line and pulls it along the ground through mid-wicket for a boundary. Moves to 97 with that.
Smacks this full delivery outside off through the covers for one run.
Wide! Too far outside off, it goes from the other side of the tramline. So, a wide is called by the umpire.
FOUR! The slower one again and this time Pant picks it up. Fuller around off, the southpaw with grace lofts it straight back over the bowler's head where there's no fielder. Boundary.
Slower one on the stumps, Pant lofts it over mid-wicket, but not cleanly. It falls safely though in the mid-wicket region and a couple of runs are collected.

FOUR! Muscle and power from Rishabh Pant. Length ball outside off, he has room to free his arms and he does so. Dismisses it out of his sight by smashing it on the up through the right of mid off for a boundary.
Width offered outside off, cracked through to sweeper cover. Single taken and that's the end of the over.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Too straight in line, Pant nudges it behind square on the leg side and comes back for the second.
Virat goes deep inside the crease and punches it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker one in line of the stumps, worked square on the leg side to rotate strike.
Flat, short and spinning in on off, Kohli goes across his sticks before punching it towards wide long on for a run.
Marlon Samuels to bowl once more.
Full and wide outside off, driven hard but straight to cover.
Waits for the ball to come to him before opening the face and running it down to third man. Single collected.
Pant gets going. Is off the mark as he flicks this full toss to deep square leg for a single.
Good length delivery in the off stump channel, Pant comes a step out and blocks it down.
Rishabh Pant to bat next.

OUT! First ODI wicket for Obed McCoy. He missed out on Kohli before, but gets Dhoni, which isn't bad at all considering the stature of the man. A back-of-the-hand length ball going across, Dhoni looks to play at it but he gets beaten as the ball goes between bat and pad. It takes the off bail and the Indian keeper is out of here. Timely breakthrough for the Windies.
Full delivery on leg, flicked off the pads through to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Powerplay 3 signalled. A maximum of 5 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings. Also, Obed McCoy is back on to bowl.
Punched away through the vacant spaces in the cover region for a single.
Worked down in front of square leg and gets to the other end.
Quicker through the air this time, on the stumps, blocked from within the crease.
Tossed up attacking the stumps, pushed back down the track.
Kohli too cuts, goes squarer than Dhoni though and finds deep point. Second single in as many balls.
Short and wide outside off, cut hard to sweeper cover for a run.
Devendra Bishoo comes back into the attack.
Comes down the track and whips it past the short mid-wicket fielder for a single.

Not out! Umpire's call. Wasn't a bad review at all to be honest. Spinning in from off, Dhoni comes half forward to work it on the leg side but is caught on the front pad. Loud shout goes up but nothing from the umpire. Nurse is confident so he tells his skipper to take it. It goes upstairs and replays show the ball to be clipping the leg stump. The review stays intact.
Review time. It's for an lbw decision against MS Dhoni. Looks close.

Good stop from Roach, saves a vital run for his side. Kohli goes deep inside the crease and works it through backward square leg. Seems it will go away to the fence, but Roach in the deep moves to his right and stops it.
Comes forward, gets close to the pitch and pushes it through mid off for one.
Floated on the stumps, paddles it but can't beat short fine leg.
Quicker through the air on off, Virat moves inside the line and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Dhoni rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
SIX! That's gone a long way! Seems he's in the mood today. Tossed up around off, Dhoni jumps out and smokes it over long off for a maximum.
Dances down, isn't exactly to the pitch but he still lofts it over mid-wicket for a double.
Short and flat, dabbed to point. No run taken.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects. One run added to the total.
Slower through the air, spinning in from outside off, VK is forward in defense.
Full and straight, not much turn, played off the outer half to short third man.
A solid punch through mid on from Virat earns him a run.
Wide! Spinning in after pitching on leg, Kohli misses his flick.
Flat, quick and outside off, punched through the cover region for three good runs. The 200 comes up for India.

There it is! 10,000 ODI runs for Virat Kohli. Superb stuff from the prolific Indian skipper. He is the quickest to get to the landmark (in 205 innings) and becomes the 4th Indian to do so. Just eases this down to long on and brings it up with a single. He looks a bit tired though. A rare sight.
Full and straight well outside off, Kohli goes for the booming drive but gets it off the outer half to short third man.
Short, flat and coming in, pulled along the carpet to deep mid-wicket for a run. Kohli on strike now.
Short and wide, Dhoni cuts it just wide of the point fielder and will keep strike.
Punched away past the cover fielder for a single.
Slight turn into the batsman, kept out from the front foot.
FOUR! Nicely done. Full and darted outside off, Kohli plays the whip-drive square through point and sends it across the boundary line. Just 2 away from 10k ODI runs now.
Spinning in, VK flicks it straight to short mid-wicket.
Looped up outside off, driven back to the bowler.
This is a surprise. Bishoo was going to continue but Marlon Samuels will take the ball now.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. End of the over.
Clips it with the spin, square on the leg side for a single. Again, it's gone off the pads. So another leg bye.
The scoreboard keeps ticking. Punched off the back foot down towards long on for a run.
Too straight in line, worked away on the leg side for another run.
Flat, short and going down, Dhoni works it in front of short fine leg and gets to the other end. It's actually gone off the pads so a leg bye is signalled.
Floats it up just outside off, wristed down to long on for one.
Tossed up delivery on off stump, pushed off the front foot towards mid off.
Going away from outside off, played square to point.
Goes on the back foot and punches it aerially to long on. One run collected.
Flighted delivery attacking the stumps, Kohli presses forward and dead-bats it.
Short and outside off, slight turn away, punched to sweeper cover for a run.
Leg break outside off, full in length, pushed with hard hands wide of short cover for a single.
Quicker through the air on the stumps, Dhoni goes back and works it to short mid-wicket. End of a successful over from Nurse.
Kohli too goes down the ground, towards long on. One more to the total.
Flicks it away with the spin. No run taken.
Dhoni is off the mark instantly. Flat and on off, punched down to long on off the back foot for a single.
MS Dhoni is the next batsman in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Windies needed a wicket and they got it. Partnership of 139 comes to an end. Off break around off, spins in and keeps low too. Rayudu looks to play the big slog sweep but it goes under his bat and disturbs the stumps behind. Nurse does it again. Can the visitors make further inroads from here?
Spinning in from outside off, cut down to short third man. A fumble from Bishoo there allows the batsmen to take a single.
Ashley Nurse to bowl again.
Uses the depth of the crease to go back and punch it down to long on. One run to end the over.
FOUR! He knows where the fielders are and he picks the gaps with perfection. Superb. Overpitched outside off by Bishoo, Kohli unfurls a beautiful cover drive and finds the fence.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On the shorter side of things once more, cut towards sweeper cover for a single.
Spinning away from a shorter length, outside off, cut through cover-point. The batsmen get a couple of runs for it.
Drifting in around off, turning away, Kohli is on the front foot to push this towards mid off. Single taken.
Devendra Bishoo is called back on.
On a length and close to off, dabbed with an open face straight to point.
Back of a length angling in on middle, with a little swivel Ambati Rayudu pulls along the ground but can't beat the diving mid-wicket fielder.

Seems the debutant injured his left shoulder on that attempted catch on the previous. We have a slight halt in play as a result. Seeing this, the umpires smartly decide to call for Drinks. Anyway, Kohli and Rayudu are motoring along comfortably without much trouble. Their century stand is up and Windies need to break this partnership. Fast. Otherwise they run the risk of conceding a big total.

Dropped! But again, a valiant attempt. Would have been a blinder had he held on to that. Length ball outside off, Rayudu slaps this aerially to the left of wide mid off. McCoy there runs to his left, dives, gets his hand to it but it's just a little far. Can't hold on. Two runs to the total.
Coming back in on a shorter length, Kohli moves across his sticks, uses the angle and pulls it along the turf wide of short fine leg for a single.
In the channel outside off, played to point. Dot ball.
Shortish outside off, Kohli offers a punch but finds the man at cover.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Full in length and outside off, driven through the gap in the covers. Another run taken.
Shows the full face of the bat and pushes it through mid on to get to the other end.
FOUR! Wow. A sight to behold. Those strong wrists of his. Full and just outside off, Kohli walks a step across, comes out and whips it through mid-wicket to find the fence.
Dabs this behind point and takes a single.
FOUR! Superb. Showing the attacking intent once again as Rayudu steps out, stays leg side and drills it through the left of mid off for a boundary.
Wide! Angling down leg, the batsman attempts to get something on it but misses.
Virat Kohli has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Dropped. Technically. No way that could have been taken. Short of a length wide outside off, slower in pace, Rayudu slaps it back to the left of the bowler. Roach sticks his hand out but can only get his fingertips on it.
Full toss coming in on middle, Ambati slogs it over mid-wicket. Wide long on covers good ground to his right and stops the ball with a slide. A brace results.
Three in three. VK swivels and pulls this short ball through to deep square leg.
Charges out to this length ball and smacks it down the ground towards long on. Another single.
Back of a length delivery on the off stick, tapped behind point with an open face. One run collected.
Kemar Roach back on.
Uses the depth of the crease to go back and present a defensive blade in response.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Takes the aerial route and gets the desired result. Rayudu stays leg side, goes inside out as he lofts it well over the covers for a boundary.
Takes the pace off this one, a length ball on off, blocked from within the crease.
Full on middle and leg, easily driven to long on to get off strike.
Fuller in length outside the line of off stump, Kohli takes a step out and drills it back to the bowler.
Length ball on off, Rayudu once again gets an inside edge which falls down beside him. 10 off the over. A good one for India.

FOUR! Second of the over. Short on middle and off, Rayudu goes across a bit, hops and pulls it through mid-wicket. Roach in the deep runs to his left, dives but can't stop it. 100-run stand comes up as well.
Angling away, slower in pace, Rayudu tries tapping it away on the off side but gets an inside edge past the off stump.

FOUR! Easy pickings for Ambati Rayudu and he gets to his fifty with that. His 9th in this format. Short and down the leg side, he pulls it down towards fine leg. The fielder there tries to stop it with a dive but cannot.
Too full and quite straight, Kohli picks it off his pads as he flicks this through square leg. Rotates strike without much trouble.
Just outside leg, flicked to fine leg for one.
Safe. Comfortably in. Ambati pushes this to mid off and both batsmen set off. There is a direct hit scored, but Rayudu is well in by then. The replays confirm the same.
A run out appeal is referred upstairs. Rayudu looks quite safe though.

FOUR! Not a bad ball at all but that's a lovely shot. Length ball on the fifth stump line, Rayudu stands tall and hammers this on the up through extra cover. Mid off gives the chase, but has no chance to stop it.
Just behind a length, outside the line of off stump, Virat walks down the track and taps it just wide of backward point. One more to the total.
Coming in at first but then straightening off the seam, Rayudu opens the bat face and guides it to third man. Gets off strike with a single.
Angling in, flicked behind square leg for a run.
Fuller in length without much pace on it, defended away into the off side for nothing.
Jason Holder returns.
Fifty for Virat Kohli. His 49th in ODI cricket. He gets to the milestone with a drive to mid off and scampers to the other end. He's well set, will look to get another big one today.
Full and outside off, Virat goes for the cover drive but misses.

In the air but just short. Back of a length which takes Rayudu by surprise. Hurries the batsman into the heave and hence he top edges it in front of square leg. Nurse from short mid-wicket runs to the ball, dives but can't get there in time. One run collected.
Outside off, going away, run down to third man with an open face. Single taken.
Short ball with not much venom in it, Rayudu wildly pulls it aerially through mid-wicket for just the one.
Angling across from a good length, on off, blocked down in front of point.
Full and on the stumps, defended with the full face off the front foot.
Short, flat and outside off, punched away into the off side for a single.
Stays on the back foot and keeps it out rather safely.
Doesn't give the batsman much room. Flat and on off, forced towards point.
Played to point again, this time by Rayudu. Dot ball.
Kohli goes square of the wicket on this occasion, through point, for a single.
Outside off, played to point to end the over.

The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single. Also, with this, Virat Kohli goes past Sachin Tendulkar as the Indian batsman with the most runs against Windies in ODIs.
Wide! Too far outside off, across the tramline and that's a wide.

DROPPED! Oh, how could you, Jason Holder? Big moment in this game. Would have been a great moment for young Obed McCoy. Full and outside off, slower in pace, Kohli looks to go big downtown but doesn't connect well at all. It skies towards long off, where Holder goes back, stretches his hands out but can't keep a hold of it. Needless to ask, how costly will that prove?
Taps it down in front of point and both batsmen complete a brisk single.
Short of a length and well outside off, Rayudu misses out on this and he knows it. Looks to cut but gets it off the bottom edge on the off side.
Pitches a length ball on the leg stump line, Virat nudges it down to fine leg and changes ends.
Good work from Roach out in the deep. Rayudu cuts this half tracker through the covers. Kemar moves to his left and stops it inside the rope. Two runs taken.
Loopy leg break outside off, firmly pushed but straight to covers.
Makes use of the feet, gets close to the pitch and defends.
Stays right behind the line and keeps it out.
Short and wide, Kohli cuts this with the turn square on the off side. Easy single results.
Short and turning away from middle and off, Virat is on the back foot as he punches this off the inner half to the right of the bowler.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Back of a length in line of the stumps, punched towards mid on. Dot ball.
Length delivery angling away from outside off, VK walks down the track, opens the face and dabs it to backward point. Can't beat Hetmyer there who dives to his left and stops it.
Fraction straight in line, wristed through square leg again but this time just for a single.
FOUR! Short ball and Rayudu latches onto this one. Moves inside the line as it's pitched on middle and pulls it aerially over square leg. One bounce and across the rope. Good shot.
Shaping away from around off, stays in the crease and pushes tamely down on the off side.
Well played. Kohli waits for this ball to turn and opens the face late to dab it past short third man. A couple of runs result.
Goes against the spin and turns it to mid-wicket for a single.
Keeps a bit low too. Flat and short on off, Rayudu chops it off the inner half down on the off side.
Touch quicker in pace, on off and full in length, Ambati defends.
Knocks this down to long on and gets to the other end. The 100 comes up for India.
Tossed right up there, on the stumps, Kohli looks to play the whip-drive through the covers but gets an inside edge back onto his pads.
On a length, on middle stump, worked in front of square leg for an easy run.
Short and wide, Virat slaps the cut through the covers. The sweeper cuts it off and keeps the batsmen to two.
Too straight in line, wristed to square leg for a single.
Cut away but a good save from Hetmyer. Some room on offer outside off, Ambati plays it towards point.
Touch shorter this time, on middle and off, Rayudu gets behind the line and defends it down on the leg side.
Angling across from a good length as the left-arm pacer serves it around off, Rayudu hangs back and taps it down on the off side.
Debutant Obed McCoy is into the attack now.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. They pick up a single.
Short and around off, punched through the covers for a single.
Nice! This is much better. Floated around off, spins away ever so slightly and barely misses the outside edge of Virat Kohli's defensive bat.

FOUR! The 50-run stand is up with that. Poor length again from Bishoo, the line isn't great either. Short and wide outside off, Kohli camps back and cuts it square through point for the second boundary of the over.
Loops it up on off, blocked off the front foot.
FOUR! Poor from Bishoo. A half tracker on the stumps, Kohli rocks back and whips it through short fine leg for a boundary. The timing was excellent on that.

Drinks break. A partnership developing for India after they lost both their openers inside Powerplay 1. Windies will be content with the way this game has gone so far for them. But they will need to keep chipping away at the wickets to gain an upper hand. Needless to say, Virat Kohli is the key once again. If they manage to remove him now, India's middle order will be exposed. Let's see how the visiting team fares in the middle overs.
Turning back into the batsman, Kohli helps it off his pads to deep square leg for a run.
Presses forward and pushes it with the gentle hands towards short third man for a run.
Shorter in length and outside off, Rayudu plays a square cut but fails to place it in the gap. Finds short third man.
Goes deep inside the crease to a short ball and strokes it down the ground to long on for a run.
Floated full ball on off, Kohli plays it with the spin to mid-wicket.
An off spinner, landing short around off, Rayudu stays back, allows the ball to spin back in and then works it through square leg. One run added to the total.
Flatter and around leg, it's flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single. Slowly but steadily this partnership is building. It's worth 41 now off 44 balls.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Gives this one some extra flight to tempt the batsman. Rayudu runs down the track to go hard at it. Fails to middle his shot properly and ends up pushing it back to Bishoo.
Fuller and flatter on middle, forced down to long on for a run.
Tossed up ball on middle, a leg spinner. Kohli lunges and defends it to the off side.
Flighted and full on off, Rayudu strides forward and pushes it in front of square on the off side. The point fielder picks up the ball and they cross for a run.
Allows the ball to spin back in and punches it to long on for a run.
Flighted and on middle, driven down through mid on for a single.

EDGY FOUR! A flighted ball landing wide outside off, Kohli leans forward, stretches out for it as he tries to drive away from the body but the ball doesn't spin back in much. As a result, it catches the outside edge and speeds past short third man for a boundary.
Flighted and on middle, clipped with the spin through square leg for a run.
Gets forward and eases a full ball through mid off for a single.
Short and on middle, pulled to deep square leg for a run.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single. Rayudu will keep strike with himself. It's been 10 balls now that Kohli hasn't been on strike.
Too full in length on off, Rayudu pushes it out to the off side.
Beaten! Big turn on this occasion. Bishoo slows this one and gets it to dip into the batsman around off. Rayudu tries to defend but it spins away and beats his bat.
This time on the leg side. Rayudu once again dances down the track and whips it in front of square leg. Good enough placement to pick a couple of runs.
FOUR! Wow, what a shot! Bishoo flights this one in the air and lands it full around off, Rayudu shimmies down the track and drills his drive through covers. No chance for the fielder in the deep.
Flighted ball around off, Rayudu comes down the track and brings his bat and pad together in defense. The keeper lets out an appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Nurse is now too straight in his line, Rayudu works it with the spin to deep square leg and collects a single. 7 coming from this over.

FOUR! Lovely shot! That will release all the pressure. Nurse gives this one some extra air but lands it fuller in length outside off. Rayudu takes a stride forward, opens the face of the bat and crunches it through extra cover for a boundary.
Full and flighted on off, hit back to the bowler.
Flatter and around leg, Rayudu plays it back from the crease. Nurse moves across to his right to stop the ball.
Spinning back into the batsman from outside off, a touch on the shorter side, Kohli goes deep inside the crease and punches it down to long on for a run.
Short and wide outside off, Rayudu cuts it from the crease to sweeper cover for a single.
Loopy leg spinner outside off, it's driven with the turn towards backward point. 3 from Bishoo's first over.
Strides forward and forces it down to long off. The fielder fumbles slightly but no extra run taken.
Floated full ball on off, turning away, Kohli lunges and pushes it with an angled bat. It races through cover-point, past the diving Hetmyer and they take a run.
This time the length is very full around leg, Ambati drives it down to long off for a run.
Tossed up ball on off, turning away a bit, Rayudu goes back and plays it down to point.
Too full in length on off, Rayudu digs it out back to the bowler.
Bowling change. It's time for some leg spin from Devendra Bishoo. There is surely assistance from the pitch, let's see how he goes. A slip in place...
Flighted on off, eased down the ground to long on for a run.
Presses forward to a full ball and drives it back to the bowler.
Rayudu has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter on off, defended off the back foot.
Tickles it with the spin to mid-wicket for a run.

Cry of anguish by the Indian skipper as he ran two but is found to be one short. A long hop on middle, Virat pulls it through mid-wicket and scampers across for a couple of runs. Only one will be added to the total.
Powerplay 2 signalled. Which means a maximum of 4 fielders will be allowed outside the ring till the end of the 40th over.
Uppish but safe! Roach angles in a full ball on middle, Kohli leans forward to flick but fails to control his shot much. It flies in the air but goes safely through mid on for a run.

Superb fielding by Samuels. Kohli packs a punch to this one and it's racing through covers. But Samuels inside the ring at covers dives full length to his left to make the stop. Stops a certain boundary.
Roach angles in a length ball on off, Kohli presents the full face of his bat and pushes it delightfully past the bowler and the diving mid off fielder. A couple taken.

Fine delivery to beat the outside edge. Roach delivers it slightly from wide of the crease. He angles it just outside off and gets it to straighten a bit from there. Kohli is caught pushing and missing inside the line.
FOUR! Feed him room and you will suffer every time. Roach bowls it short and outside off, Kohli rocks on the back foot and punches it sweetly through covers for a glorious boundary.
Good running. Back of a length delivery on off, Rayudu taps it down in front of point and steals a run.
Tossed up ball outside off, Kohli plays a little late cut but finds the short third man fielder. Fantastic over by Ashley, a wicket and only 2 runs coming off it.
Flatter delivery on off, stroked off the back foot to long on for a run.
Ambati Rayudu is the number 4 batsman.

OUT! That's hitting leg. Success for Windies. They have now removed both the Indian openers, that too, quite cheaply. A great use of the technology by the visiting team. Nurse bowls this one slower through the air and lands it around leg. Dhawan closes the face of his bat as he tries to tap it on the leg side. But he fails to make any connection and is rapped on the pads. They appeal but the umpire turns it down. Nurse, though, is very sure and convinces Holder to take the DRS. The replays roll in and it shows that the ball has straightened after landing and it's travelling to meet the leg pole. Dhawan walks back shaking his head.
Appeal for an lbw! It's not given. Ashley Nurse though is very sure and convinces his skipper to take the DRS. Let's see...
Sliding down the leg side, Dhawan tries to flick but misses and it goes off his pads to the on side.

What happened there? Oh dear, in his delivery stride, Nurse has stamped on the right foot of umpire Ian Gould. The bowler has to pull out as a result and later on apologizes. That's a first for me on a cricket field.
Wide! Wrong line. Nurse sprays it down the leg side, Shikhar tries flicking but misses. The umpire exercises his arms.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched from the crease to covers.
Floated full ball landing on middle. A bit of visible turn there. Dhawan tries to work it on the leg side but it takes the leading edge and goes to covers.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball outside off and defends it watchfully.

Nearly drags it on. Roach overpitches outside off, Dhawan goes at it with firm hands as he tries to drive through the line. But it takes the inner half of his blade and rolls past the stumps to short fine leg. A single added to the total.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Angling into the batsman around off, Dhawan defends. A good start from Shikhar, so far. He will be eyeing a big score after a flop show in the last match.

SIX! Just over the fielder at third man. Roach digs in a short delivery outside off, Dhawan ramps it over and for a moment it appears that it will find the fielder. But the ball eventually has enough wings to sail over Powell.
Good length ball angling into the batsman from 'round the wicket, Dhawan defends it off his back foot to the leg side.
Kemar Roach to continue...
Shortish and on off, Dhawan punches it off his back foot to long off for one. Good start from Nurse.
Lovely delivery. Nurse bowls a nicely loopy ball on off. It skids on after landing and Dhawan keeps it out off his back foot.
A slip in for Dhawan.
Tossed up ball on middle, Kohli works it off the inner half of his bat to the left of the short fine leg fielder. A single taken.
Spinning down the leg side, Kohli clips it off his pads but it rolls straight to square leg.
Quicker and flatter outside off, Kohli plays it late from the crease towards short third man.
Flighted full ball on off, turning back in a bit, Kohli flicks but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Bowling change. Jason Holder is introducing the spin of Ashley Nurse in the seventh over.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and offers a straight blade in defense. Tidy over by Roach, just one coming off it.

Roach operates from 'round the wicket for the southpaw. He angles in a length ball on off, Dhawan drives it straight back and Kemar does well in his followthrough to take the pace off the ball. He deflects it towards mid on as the Indian skipper was seen diving inside his crease. Good awareness.
Keeps it on a length and outside off, Kohli plays at it with an angled bat past the sliding backward point fielder. The third man fielder though is quite square and that's why only a run is possible.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Angling into the batsman, on a good length, Kohli defends it firmly to the off side.
Finds point. Roach bowls it full and wide outside off, Kohli walks forward and drives it square of the wicket on the off side. Just short of the fielder.
Holder switches to over the wicket and bowls it on a fuller length around off. Dhawan strides forward and pushes it with gentle hands to mid off. 10 from the over!
FOUR! No half measures there! This is absolutely crashed. Holder delivers it short and wide outside off, Dhawan rocks back and whacks it through backward point for a boundary.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! Deliberate edge? Holder dishes out a length delivery in the channel outside off. Dhawan looks to play it with an angled bat but it takes the outside half of his blade and runs through the vacant first slip region for a boundary.
The pace is very gentle from Holder. He drops it on a good length around off, Dhawan plays it late but still finds the point fielder with his little dab shot.
Serving on the pads of the left-hander, Dhawan nudges it in front of square leg. There is protection in the deep now and hence only a couple.
Keeps it full but wide outside off, Kohli is in no mood to chase it away from his body. End of a successful over for Windies, 4 runs and the wicket of Rohit from it.
Roach reverts to his line outside off, on a good length, Kohli shoulders arms.

FOUR! Off the mark on the third ball he faces. A classy shot. Roach delivers it on a full length and outside off, Virat strides forward and unfurls a beautiful square drive for a boundary. Lovely placement. The skipper is up and running.
Another delivery outside off has been left alone with ease by the Indian skipper.
Bowls it on a length and outside off, Kohli allows it through.
Huge cheer from the crowd. India's superstar and skipper, Virat Kohli arrives in the centre. He averages 99.75 at this venue. Bradman-esque! Also, Kohli is only 81 away from reaching 10k ODI runs.

OUT! A soft dismissal for Rohit Sharma. Roach is lucky to get this wicket, to be honest. It's short and wide outside off, begging to be hit, Rohit obliges and cracks it off his back foot. But he fails to get the placement right. Also, it's hit aerially and goes straight into the hands of Hetmyer at backward point. He makes no mistake and India suffer an early blow.

Goes for a big one, an aerial shot but hasn't got enough meat on it. Holder digs in a short ball and Dhawan drags his pull shot over wide mid on. It falls in the deep before the rope and stops. The fielder retrieves it and they take a couple of runs.
Fine leg comes up. Square leg drops back.
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, Dhawan defends it off his back foot to covers. Was looking for tap and run there but the fielder quickly got to the ball.
Slower one, around off, Dhawan is solid in defense.

FOUR! Impeccable timing by Dhawan again. Holder overdoes his length this time, it's full and around off, Dhawan plays it with the angle and flicks it past the left side of the mid-wicket fielder. Hemraj gives the chase but fails to pull it back before the fence.

FOUR! Dhawan also has a boundary to his name now. Holder bowls it shortish and it's angled into the batsman. Dhawan shuffles across a bit and helps it around through square leg. Good timing and it races away to the fence.
A touch short in length and outside off, shaping back in with the angle, Dhawan taps it down from the crease to point.
Switches to over the wicket for the right-hander. Bowls it on a fuller length around off, Rohit prods forward and blocks. A watchful beginning by India.
Off the mark, finally. Roach is a little too straight on this occasion with his line, Dhawan helps it behind square leg and takes a run.
Dot ball again. Lands it on a length and outside off, Dhawan remains on the back foot and plays it down towards cover-point. Wants a single but it's not on.
A little bit of extra bounce this time, around off, Dhawan goes back and turns it on the leg side.
Full in length and outside off, angling into the batsman, Dhawan strides forward and pushes it to the off side.
Roach runs in from 'round the wicket and serves a good length delivery on off, Dhawan remains on the back foot and defends it.
Kemar Roach is given the second new ball from the other end. A false start first up as Dhawan wasn't ready and pulls out. Reload, Roach...
Some inward movement on this occasion. It lands a bit shortish and outside off. Rohit offers no shot and watches it go to the keeper.
Good length delivery in the zone outside off, Sharma makes a leave.
FOUR! Rohit is off the mark! Holder errs in his line and serves it on the pads of the batsman. Rohit deflects it neatly and finds the fence at fine leg. India are away as well.
Back of a length delivery around off, Rohit taps it down from the crease towards gully and looks for a run. But his partner is not interested as Nurse gets to the ball from first slip.
Watchfully left. A harmless delivery, on a length and outside off, Sharma allows it through to the keeper.

A cracking piece of fielding at point! Holder starts with a good length delivery in the channel outside off, Rohit hits it firmly square of the wicket on the off side where Hetmyer dives full length to his right from backward point to make an outstanding stop.

Out come the Indian openers. It's a jam-packed stadium here in Vizag. Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan are the openers, as usual. India will be hoping for a big start from this pair. Jason Holder has the first new ball in his hand as he runs in to bowl the first over of the match. A slip in place. Here we go...

Windies' skipper, Jason Holder says that he isn't too bothered about bowling first. Reckons that the pitch won't change much throughout the course of this game. Adds that they would like to restrict the Indian team and then take the run chase deep. Admits that they need to be clinical with the bat during the chase. Informs about the one change, Obed McCoy is making his debut, replacing Oshane Thomas in the playing XI.

India's skipper, Virat Kohli says that it looks a good wicket and may get slower in the second half which also suits their bowling combination for this match. Mentions that Kuldeep Yadav is playing in place of Khaleel Ahmed and feels that it's a perfect bowling combination to defend the total.
Toss - Up goes the coin and it comes down in favour of the home team. INDIA ELECT TO BAT!

Pitch report - It's a very dry looking surface with no live grass. The bowlers will have to get their lengths right and have to rely on their variations. There will be help for the spinners. Also, dew might be a factor later on in the evening. Chasing appears to be a better option here.

Welcome, folks. It's time for the second ODI in the extreme heat of Visakhapatnam. Windies were humbled in the first game and would be hoping for a better performance in this outing, especially with the ball. The Men in Blue, on the other hand, would just look to keep their winning momentum going and register yet another comprehensive win. Will we see a more competitive game today? Stay with us to find out.
